title: Gemini 3.7 Flash pairs stronger agent performance with introductory pricing
friendlyTitle: Gemini 3.7 Flash is built for faster, lower-cost AI work
summary: Google positions Gemini 3.7 Flash as a workhorse model for coding and agents, reporting gains over 3.6 Flash in software engineering, document understanding and workflow automation. Introductory API pricing is $0.75 per million input tokens and $3.75 per million output tokens through 2026.
friendlySummary: Google says its new Flash model is better at coding, reading difficult documents and completing business workflows. A lower starting price lasts until the end of 2026.
whyItMatters: The model offers another price-performance option for high-volume agent and coding workloads. Buyers should benchmark their own tasks and account for the announced price doubling in January 2027 before making long-term cost assumptions.
friendlyWhyItMatters: It may reduce the cost of busy AI tools, but businesses should test it and plan for higher prices next year.
